title: Optimize Toolchains for Maximum Compile Speed
description: No dev or agent uses a step-through debugger anymore; debugging is console-log only. Reconfigure Rust (Cargo profiles, release incremental, codegen-units), TypeScript (incremental type-check), VS Code extension Vite builds (drop sourcemaps), Python (drop debugpy), .vscode/launch.json (zero debug adapters), and C# (no PDBs) for maximum compile/build speed, given a 193-crate Rust workspace where the hot path is wasm-pack/wasip2/native --release builds.
